summary: Navient Solutions, LLC, as administrator for SLM Student Loan Trust 2004-2, furnished a preliminary remarketing memorandum to remarketing agents on October 14, 2026, for distribution to qualified institutional buyers in connection with remarketing the Trust's Class A-6 Reset Rate Notes. The 8-K's Item 8.01 and Exhibit 99.1 provide pool-level student loan collateral tables as of an August 31, 2026 statistical disclosure date. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural change is stated. This is a routine ABS remarketing disclosure, not a special situation; watch reset-rate coupon pricing and any collateral deterioration in the pool tables.
